command:
set -euo pipefail; SERIAL=$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}' | head -n1); test -n "$SERIAL"; test -n "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pidof io.blueeye)"; adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -c; echo COPY_TAP; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input tap 306 2155; sleep 5; echo PID_AFTER_COPY; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pidof io.blueeye; echo SHARE_TAP; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input tap 773 2155; sleep 5; echo SHARE_UI; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/tracker-share.xml >/dev/null; adb -s "$SERIAL" pull /sdcard/tracker-share.xml /tmp/tracker-share.xml >/dev/null; python3 - <<'PY'
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
r=ET.parse('/tmp/tracker-share.xml').getroot()
for n in r.iter('node'):
 t=n.attrib.get('text',''); d=n.attrib.get('content-desc','')
 if t or d: print(f'text={t!r} desc={d!r}')
PY
echo EXPORT_FILE; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell run-as io.blueeye ls -l cache/session_exports/blueeye-session-export.json; adb -s "$SERIAL" exec-out run-as io.blueeye cat cache/session_exports/blueeye-session-export.json > /tmp/blueeye-session-export-db8c3ce.json; python3 - <<'PY'
import json,hashlib,pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('/tmp/blueeye-session-export-db8c3ce.json')
b=p.read_bytes(); d=json.loads(b)
print('export_bytes='+str(len(b)))
print('export_sha256='+hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest())
print('deviceCount='+str(d.get('deviceCount')))
print('sampleCount='+str(d.get('sampleCount')))
assert len(b)>512*1024, len(b)
assert d.get('deviceCount')==12, d.get('deviceCount')
assert d.get('sampleCount')==1782, d.get('sampleCount')
PY
echo PID_AFTER_SHARE; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pidof io.blueeye; echo CRASH_SCAN; if adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -d -v brief | grep -E 'TransactionTooLargeException|FATAL EXCEPTION|Process: io.blueeye|DeadObjectException'; then echo CRASH_SIGNATURE_FOUND; exit 1; else echo NO_CRASH_SIGNATURES; fi; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input keyevent KEYCODE_BACK || true; sleep 1; echo DB_POST; SNAP=$(mktemp); D=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -f "$SNAP"; rm -rf "$D"' EXIT; adb -s "$SERIAL" exec-out run-as io.blueeye tar cf - databases > "$SNAP"; tar xf "$SNAP" -C "$D"; sqlite3 "$D/databases/tracker_database" 'PRAGMA integrity_check; select count(*) from devices; select count(*) from signal_samples; select count(*) from follow_me_observations;'; echo PHYSICAL_LARGE_EXPORT_REGRESSION_PASS
